## RE:volution Mod v1.5.1

### Added

- Added regression coverage for a completed 26/26 rune purchase stage.
- Added regression coverage for a completed nested cycle with 25 runes at the current lower rank and 1 rune already at a higher rank.

### Fixed

- Fixed a login/stat-sync crash when the active rune purchase stage was already complete.
- `PlayerStatsSyncService` no longer evaluates the 26-point purchase TABLE curve with `lowerProgress = 26`.
- Completed purchase stages now report `purchaseUnitCost = 0` instead of clamping to the last configured curve point or evaluating a nonexistent 27th purchase point.

### Other

- The v1.5.0 ZBT Draft balance snapshot is unchanged.
- Purchase pressure, duplicate compensation, enhancement costs, rank-up costs, Rune Rank Revert policy, poison/AoE balance and Location 1 balance are unchanged.
- Rank 4 is not added in this release.
- Mongo schema and Balance Core schema version remain unchanged.

### Download

Use the matching server and client gameplay artifact published for this stable release.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v1.5.0...v1.5.1
